info.name: SCIM Server
info.summary: Account lifecycle management from an identity provider such as authentik, using SCIM 2.0
info.description:
**Caution: this app was programmed entirely with AI (Claude Code).** It has unit tests and an automated end-to-end suite, and has been tested by hand with authentik (OpenID Connect) and Microsoft Entra ID (SAML). It creates, disables and deletes accounts: try it on a test instance first and keep backups.
Lets an external identity provider (authentik, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, ...) manage Nextcloud accounts and groups through **SCIM 2.0**, with no extra service to run.
- Accounts are **provisioned** when they appear in the IdP and **updated** when they change (display name, email, group membership). - Deprovisioning is up to you: **disable** the account, **disable and delete after N days**, or delete at once. - Accounts disabled in the IdP are blocked from logging in, and reactivated when they come back. - Authenticates with revocable bearer tokens that are stored hashed.
Users still sign in through your SSO app (user_oidc or user_saml); this app only manages their lifecycle. See the README for the authentik setup.
